lines.en: I swim slowly. There is no hurry.

lines.zh: 这身肉太重，划一下走不了多远。
lines.en: This bulk is heavy. One stroke goes a short way.

lines.zh: 我沿着河底的水草往前挪。
lines.en: I move along the river-bed weeds.

lines.zh: 尾巴一压，水把我推出去。
lines.en: One press of my tail and the water carries me.
I swim the shallows where the water is warm.
My back breaks the surface now and then.
The water is slow in this bend. Good for travel.
I go around the sunken logs.

lines.zh: 水底的泥很软，陷下去一脚。
lines.en: The bed is soft and my flipper sinks in.
I chew as I swim.

lines.zh: 我抬起头换气，又低下去。
lines.en: I lift my head to breathe, then lower it.
This river is wide enough for me.
I hang in the water, chewing slowly.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子有两块肉，能合上。
lines.en: My snout has two flaps that can close.

lines.zh: 水底的草被我啃短了一片。
lines.en: I have cropped a patch of weed short.

lines.zh: 小河豚从我身边游过去。
lines.en: A small puffer drifts past me.
I settle on the bottom and do not move.
Sunlight enters and falls on my back.
I listen to the sounds above the surface.
There are old scars on this hide.

lines.zh: 我啃过的地方，草只剩短茬。
lines.en: Where I've grazed, only stubble is left.

lines.zh: 我一点也不急，水里没有路要赶。
lines.en: I am in no hurry. There is no road to rush.

lines.zh: 背上的水草挂了一会儿，掉了。
lines.en: Weed clings to my back, then falls away.
I raise a flipper and let it fall.
The water in this river is warm.

lines.zh: 有鱼在啃我的皮，我不理。
lines.en: Fish nibble my hide. I ignore them.

lines.zh: 你站在岸上看了我很久。
lines.en: You have watched me from the bank a long while.
I am too big to hide.
Come in. The water is not deep.
I am not afraid of you, nor do I need to be.

lines.zh: 我浮上来，你就退了半步。
lines.en: I surfaced and you stepped back half a pace.

lines.zh: 你的船要是过来，我就让。
lines.en: If your boat comes, I move aside.

lines.zh: 我身上没有你要的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing on me that you want.
I have lived in this river longer than you.

lines.zh: 你手里那根竿子，收起来吧。
lines.en: Put that pole away.
When I lift my head, my nostrils whistle.
You need not fear me rolling over.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，你走两步就跟上了。
lines.en: I swim slowly. Two steps keep pace.

lines.zh: 你的影子在水里，看着像条大鱼。
lines.en: Your shadow in the water looks like a big fish.
I do not eat people. Do not imagine things.

lines.zh: 这河里安静，你也该安静。
lines.en: This river is quiet. Be quiet too.
I am going up for air.

lines.zh: 你踩在岸边的泥上，那块会塌。
lines.en: The bank mud under you will give way.

lines.zh: 你走的时候，别把网留下。
lines.en: When you leave, do not leave your net.

lines.zh: 这一下打在皮厚的地方。
lines.en: That landed where the hide is thick.
Sink a little, then rise again.
Blood in water spreads quickly.
I shift half a body length deeper.

lines.zh: 亚马逊的浑水，我慢慢吃草。
lines.en: In the Amazon's murk, I graze slowly.
I flap a flipper and water scatters.
Underwater the wound does not hurt much.

lines.zh: 厚皮上又多了一道白痕。
lines.en: Another pale scar joins the others on my thick hide.
I can still swim. That will do.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转开，躲到水草后。
lines.en: I turn away behind the weeds.

lines.zh: 水草就在那儿，我自己会吃。
lines.en: The weeds are right there. I feed myself.

lines.zh: 亚马逊的水草，我吃得慢。
lines.en: Amazon weeds, and I eat slowly.
I chew my weed and watch you slowly.
I will not eat that. I will not even sniff it.
What you dropped has sunk.
I ate that clump of weed.
I have eaten many kinds of river weed.

lines.zh: 你不用喂我，河里有的是。
lines.en: You need not feed me. The river has plenty.
I chew slowly, and it is loud.

lines.zh: 你拿它晃来晃去，我也不动。
lines.en: Wave it about and I still will not move.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一堵软的墙。
lines.en: You hit me like a soft wall.
This flesh does not bounce.
Did you step on my back?
Give me room. I am surfacing.
I am beside you. There is no need to push.
The little boat touched me and rocked.
I do not dodge. I could not dodge quickly anyway.
I push the water and you drift back.

lines.zh: 你的腿在我背上蹭了一下。
lines.en: Your leg brushed my back.
I move half a body length away.
Even this body can have company.

lines.zh: 两副厚背一起浮起来换气。
lines.en: Two broad backs surface together to breathe.
Its back is broader than mine.
We move along the bed together.
When it calls, the water shivers.

lines.zh: 这么慢的日子，两个人也一样慢。
lines.en: Slow days are just as slow with two.
We share the same patch of weed.

lines.zh: 小的时候，它一直跟着我。
lines.en: When it was small it followed me everywhere.
This river can feed us both.
In the water no promises are made.
Something shines on the river bed.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币在水底翻了个身。
lines.en: The coin rolls over on the riverbed.
Too heavy for me to carry.

lines.zh: 我咬起一片落下来的树叶。
lines.en: I take up a fallen leaf.
I leave what is inside the wreck.
This log has been softened by water.
I push it onto the shallow shelf.

lines.zh: 有人的东西掉进河里了。
lines.en: Someone's belongings fell into the river.

lines.zh: 我推着一只沉船的铁罐走了几步。
lines.en: I nudge a sunken tin along for a few steps.
What drifts down the river, I do not keep.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子不是我的。
lines.en: That shadow on the surface is not mine.
Someone entered the water, stepping loudly.
I need not chase. He will not get far.
He is two steps upstream of me.

lines.zh: 你搅起的泥，顺着水飘到我这儿。
lines.en: The silt you stirred drifts down to me.
His scent is in the water.
He stands still in the shallows.
I have his legs in view.
From here one push reaches him.
His back is to the river.
I sink and pass underneath.
The weeds hide me from him.
I am not fast, but he will tire.

lines.zh: 他手里拿着东西，没举起来。
lines.en: He holds something and has not raised it.

lines.zh: 这处水湾只有我们两个。
lines.en: Only the two of us are in this bend.

lines.zh: 他一步步退回浅滩去了。
lines.en: He backs away toward the shallows.
I stay behind him the whole way.
The sound of his wading has changed.
I move slowly past his legs.
I stir the silt beneath.
He stops to catch his breath.
I lift my head for a breath.
He is just ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我的身体把水推得很明显。
lines.en: My body pushes the water plainly.
He has finally heard it.
He turns and throws up a splash.
I neither retreat nor rush.
He goes toward midstream, water to his waist.
I am two body lengths behind him.
He shouted. Nobody on the bank.
He grabs the weeds to steady himself.
He should not have come into the water.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子出水，他没看见。
lines.en: My snout breaks the surface and he does not see.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍几乎不摆，怕惊动水。
lines.en: My tail barely moves; I don't want to stir the water.

lines.zh: 我一侧身把他推倒在水里。
lines.en: I turn my flank and push him into the water.
My tail sweeps and the water opens.
I heave with my back and tip him over.
He grips my hide and slides off.
I press him under.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，可他站不住。
lines.en: That was not heavy, yet he cannot stand.
He chokes and grabs at nothing.

lines.zh: 我把它顶到河心的深水。
lines.en: I push him into the deep middle.
His pole drifts away.
I turn slowly to face him.

lines.zh: 他扒着岸边的草，我停住了。
lines.en: He clings to the bank grass and I stop.

lines.zh: 我把身体挡在他和岸之间。
lines.en: I put my body between him and the bank.
He elbows my snout.
I recoil once and push back.
He has finally climbed ashore.
I do not follow him up.
I rise slowly from the bottom.
My back shows above the surface first.
A string of bubbles breaks the surface.

lines.zh: 这身肉比我以为的更沉。
lines.en: This body weighs more than I expected.

lines.zh: 河边的水草够我吃很久。
lines.en: The weeds along this bank will feed me a while.

lines.zh: 我在浅水里停住，慢慢呼吸。
lines.en: I stop in the shallows and breathe slowly.
The temperature in this river is just right.
I lift my head and look at both banks.

lines.zh: 水底的泥被我一压，陷下去。
lines.en: The bed sinks where I press down.
There is a small boat not far off.
I turn slowly downstream.

lines.zh: 我这么大的身体，水里也算安静。
lines.en: Large as I am, I am quiet in the water.
The river lies still as cloth.
I raise a flipper and slap the water.
The weeds on this side are newly grown.

lines.zh: 我游进来的时候，没有声音。
lines.en: I made no sound coming in.
A few small fish trail behind me.

lines.zh: 气泡先上来，然后才是我的鼻子。
lines.en: Bubbles rise first, then my nose.
The surface is burning and I sink below it.

lines.zh: 水退得太快，我摔在泥上。
lines.en: The water fell too fast and I landed on mud.
A net tangles me and I cannot reach the surface.

lines.zh: 爆响在水里闷闷地推了我一把。
lines.en: The blast shoved me dully through the water.
A harpoon stands in my back.
Strange light burns beneath my hide.
This patch of weed has been grazed bare.

lines.zh: 雷击在水面，我全身一颤。
lines.en: Lightning hit the surface and my whole body shook.

lines.zh: 河底的泥裂开，我掉下去。
lines.en: The riverbed split, and I fell through.
